ideas.truth: Diwali sweets feel special when you can see they were made fresh by hand, not mass-produced.
ideas.moment: The shopkeeper's own hand carefully stacking a batch of just-cut kaju katli onto a brass thali moments before the shop opens for Diwali rush.
ideas.key_frame: A hand in a soft pink sleeve places glistening, freshly cut diamond kaju katli onto a marigold-strewn brass thali beside two glowing diyas.

ideas.truth: Diwali abundance is best expressed visually — a table that looks like it's overflowing with sweets says 'celebration' instantly.
ideas.moment: The exact instant a mound of kaju katli is arranged so generously it looks like more than anyone could finish — mirroring the '250g FREE' offer.
ideas.key_frame: An overflowing brass thali piled high with kaju katli diamonds, marigold petals scattered around, diyas glowing at the edges of frame.

ideas.truth: In old bazaars like Johari Bazaar, the craft and detail of a single sweet is the real proof of quality.
ideas.moment: A macro moment of one perfect kaju katli catching the light, showing its silver vark and clean cut edges.
ideas.key_frame: Macro close-up of a single silver-vark-topped kaju katli diamond resting on a bed of dry fruits against a deep maroon backdrop.

why: The hand-placing-sweets moment adds warmth and a sense of freshly-made-by-hand craft (solving the 'make it look fresh' brief) while still leaving clean, calm space for the mandatory Hindi/English copy.
treatment: A vertical festive poster. In the lower-middle of the frame, a hand gently arranges neatly cut, glistening kaju katli diamonds onto a brass thali scattered with marigold petals, two diyas glowing warmly beside it. The background is a soft, blurred deep-maroon drape with faint golden bokeh, evoking the warmth of a Diwali evening in Johari Bazaar. Light is warm and golden-hour, catching the moist, fresh sheen of the sweets and the silver vark on top. The top third of the frame stays a clean, dark-maroon gradient for the दिवाली धमाका headline; the bottom third stays calm and uncluttered for the offer line and shop details. Overall mood: premium, appetizing, festive, trustworthy — a sweet shop that still makes things by hand.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 festive product poster photo. A hand in a soft pink saree sleeve places freshly cut diamond kaju katli — ivory-white, silver vark, crisp moist edges — onto a brass thali with marigold petals and two lit diyas. Background: blurred rich maroon drape, warm golden bokeh, soft golden-hour light, shallow depth of field. Leave top third calm dark-maroon gradient for headline, and lower third clean for offer and shop text.
on_screen_copy: 1 kg kaju katli pe 250 g FREE

finish.copy_placement: दिवाली धमाका set large and bold in gold Devanagari type in the top-third calm zone; directly below it, smaller, the offer '1 kg kaju katli pe 250 g FREE' in a clean white/gold sans-serif; shop name 'Shree Ganesh Sweets' and 'Johari Bazaar, Jaipur' set in a compact bottom card/banner over the lower-third calm zone.
finish.end_card: Not applicable — single static poster frame serves as its own end card, with shop name and location anchored at the bottom.
finish.music: Not applicable — static image for WhatsApp Status/Instagram, no audio needed.
